title: Your first day
summary: The daily loop: a project, a task, a worker, the board, merge and Done.

steps.text: A project is a folder with your code. Corvid keeps tasks, agents and notes per project, so start by picking one here.
This is the task board. Add a task now: one clear job, like a bug to fix. I move on when it lands.
Start a worker on your task. A worker is a Claude Code agent on its own git branch, so your main folder stays as it is.
Each worker gets a card here. Click it to see its terminal; you can type to it like any Claude session.
Workers post on the board when they start and when they finish. The done post says what changed and what is left for you.
When the checks pass, the worker merges its branch into main and the task moves to Done. Look it over there.
A deploy is a task of its own. Workers never deploy unless a task asks for it, so add one when you want the work live.
Replay any tour from here, or ask Corvid to explain something.
